datasets.name: hill_of_towie_2021
datasets.source: Hill of Towie wind farm open dataset (RES)
conversions: time stamps moved from the end to the start of the interval (-10 min)
pitch: mean of blades A, B, C; v_ac and i_ac: mean of the three phases; t_gen_winding: mean of the windings 1U1, 1V1, 1W1
shutdown_s: ShutdownDuration of the operator's file, seconds out of 600
setpoint: the value at the end of the interval (wtc_PowerRef_endvalue), not a mean
224 rows with a repeated (device, time stamp) dropped, the first kept

datasets.name: la_haute_borne
datasets.source: La Haute Borne wind farm data (ENGIE, copy shipped with OpenOA)
datasets.license: Etalab open licence (as stated by ENGIE, not re-verified)

checks_skipped.dst: Etc/GMT-1 has no daylight saving time; set dst_zone to test a site zone

conversions: time stamps: the offsets printed in the file are ignored; the wall clock is read as UTC+1 all year (UTC = wall clock - 1 h), because the series follows standard time (see the module description); 96 rows of repeated spring stamps cannot be assigned to the hour 02:xx or 03:xx and were dropped
turbine names (R80711, ...) replaced by T01 to T04 in the order of the names; no unit conversion: kW, m/s, deg, degC

datasets.name: la_haute_borne_as_stamped
datasets.source: La Haute Borne wind farm data (ENGIE, copy shipped with OpenOA)
datasets.license: Etalab open licence (as stated by ENGIE, not re-verified)
conversions: time stamps: ISO 8601 with the printed UTC offsets read as given and converted to UTC (not reconstructed)
turbine names (R80711, ...) replaced by T01 to T04 in the order of the names; no unit conversion: kW, m/s, deg, degC
48 rows with a repeated (device, time stamp) dropped, the later one kept

datasets.name: care_A

checks_skipped.dst: UTC has no daylight saving time; set dst_zone to test a site zone

conversions: sensor_x_avg, _min, _max, _std to <signal>, <signal>__min, __max, __std (mapped sensors only)
power and reactive power are NOT converted to kW or kvar: the benchmark scales them (anonymisation) and publishes no rated power, so they are stored as p_ac_rel and q_ac_rel, dimensionless

status_type_id to status_code; iec_category from the benchmark's status ids (0 normal, 1 derated, 2 idling, 3 service, 4 downtime, 5 other), an interpretation the benchmark does not publish as IEC categories

datasets.name: pvdaq_34

checks_skipped.dst: Etc/GMT+8 has no daylight saving time; set dst_zone to test a site zone
checks_skipped.power_curve: needs a wind table with power (p_ac or p_ac_rel) and wind_speed
checks_skipped.icing: needs a wind table with t_amb and wind_speed

conversions: p_ac, p_dc: hectowatts to kW (x0.1) before 2018-08-04 19:45 UTC (start of the first interval in watts), watts to kW (x0.001) from then on; 99th percentile of the AC power of the inverters after conversion: 0.73 of the array's kWp
t_amb, t_module: degrees Fahrenheit to degrees Celsius
wind_speed: mph to m/s
power_factor: raw value / 1000
time stamps: local standard time (UTC-8) to UTC, rounded to 15 min, moved from the end to the start of the interval
4354 rows that fall on the same 15-minute stamp after rounding dropped, the first kept
